description: This is a unit test class for the security_utils.php utility functions in SuiteCRM, testing access control, user roles, modules, IP retrieval, and configuration functions.

classes.name: security_utilsTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing security utility functions in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: testquery_module_access_list
methods.description: Tests the function query_module_access_list to ensure it returns expected access list for a user.

methods.name: testquery_user_has_roles
methods.description: Tests the function query_user_has_roles to verify role retrieval for a user.

methods.name: testget_user_allowed_modules
methods.description: Tests the function get_user_allowed_modules to verify allowed modules list.

methods.name: testget_user_disallowed_modules
methods.description: Tests the function get_user_disallowed_modules to verify disallowed modules for a user.

methods.name: testquery_client_ip
methods.description: Tests the function query_client_ip to ensure it correctly retrieves the client's IP address from server variables.

methods.name: testget_val_array
methods.description: Tests the function get_val_array to verify it correctly maps array keys to their values.
